user.title: Connect to your feeder
user.description: Enter the address of the feeder running the Kibble agent.

error.cannot_connect: No Kibble agent answered at that address.
error.unknown: The agent answered but the response could not be read.

abort.already_configured: This feeder is already set up.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Dispense food from one or both augers.

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.description: Which hopper to run. With the divider fitted, "both" dispenses the amount from each hopper; with it removed there is one shared bin and "both" dispenses the amount from it once.

amount2.name: Amount (hopper 2)
amount2.description: Portions to dispense from hopper 2, when hopper is "both" and a different split from hopper 1 is wanted. Defaults to the same as Amount.

id.name: Feed ID
id.description: Optional identifier recorded with the feed event.

cancel_feed.name: Cancel feed
cancel_feed.description: Stop a dispense that is in progress.

schedule_set.name: Set schedule
schedule_set.description: Replace the whole feed schedule with a new list of entries.

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: The full replacement list, each with time, hopper1_g, hopper2_g and optionally enabled/entry_id.

schedule_add.name: Add schedule entry
schedule_add.description: Add one entry to the feed schedule.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to add an entry to.

schedule_remove.name: Remove schedule entry
schedule_remove.description: Remove one entry from the feed schedule.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to remove an entry from.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The id from sensor.cat_feeder_schedule's entries attribute.

schedule_set_enabled.name: Enable/disable schedule entry
schedule_set_enabled.description: Turn one feed-schedule entry on or off without removing it.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: The id from sensor.cat_feeder_schedule's entries attribute.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the entry should be active.

schedule_card_add.name: Add schedule card entry
schedule_card_add.description: Thin adapter for the embedded dispenser-schedule-card: add one entry, delegating to schedule_add with one amount mirrored to both hoppers.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to add an entry to.

id.name: Entry ID
id.description: Ignored: the feeder assigns the id. Accepted so the schedule card's add action validates.

schedule_card_edit.name: Edit schedule card entry
schedule_card_edit.description: Thin adapter for the embedded dispenser-schedule-card: change an existing entry's time and amount in place.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to edit an entry on.

schedule_card_remove.name: Remove schedule card entry
schedule_card_remove.description: Thin adapter for the embedded dispenser-schedule-card: remove one entry, delegating to schedule_remove.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to remove an entry from.

schedule_card_toggle.name: Toggle schedule card entry
schedule_card_toggle.description: Thin adapter for the embedded dispenser-schedule-card: flip one entry's own enabled state.

wifi_connect.name: Connect to Wi-Fi network
wifi_connect.description: Switch the feeder to a different Wi-Fi network, or reconnect to one it already has a saved password for. Fails safe: a wrong password or unreachable network rolls back to the previous connection automatically.

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: The Wi-Fi network to connect to.

password.name: Password
password.description: Leave empty to reconnect to a network Kibble already has a saved password for.

save_clip.name: Save clip
save_clip.description: Download audio from an HA media source or URL, convert it, and store it on the feeder as a named clip.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to save a clip on.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A media-source reference (e.g. from tts.speak) or a direct audio URL.

record_clip.name: Record clip
record_clip.description: Record from the feeder's own microphone and store it on the feeder as a named clip.

play_clip.name: Play clip
play_clip.description: Play an already-stored clip through the feeder's speaker.

device_id.name: Feeder
device_id.description: The feeder to play a clip on.

name.name: Clip name
name.description: The stored clip's name, from sensor.cat_feeder_clips's attributes or GET /clips.

beep.name: Beep
beep.description: Play the MCU buzzer once (KibbleOS only).

on_ms.name: Beep length
on_ms.description: How long each beep lasts, in milliseconds.

off_ms.name: Gap length
off_ms.description: How long the silence between beeps lasts, in milliseconds.

call_cats.name: Call the cats
call_cats.description: Play the feeding cue through the feeder's speaker on demand (KibbleOS only). Does not dispense food.

set_desiccant.name: Set desiccant
set_desiccant.description: Set the desiccant pack's remaining days or its rated replacement interval (KibbleOS only).

days_left.name: Days left
days_left.description: How many days remain before the desiccant pack should be replaced.

interval_days.name: Replacement interval
interval_days.description: How many days a fresh desiccant pack is rated to last.

clear_training.name: Clear training photos
clear_training.description: Remove training photos and rebuild the identity model. Never touches event history.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: A cat's name, or "all" for every enrolled cat.

keep_uploads.name: Keep uploaded photos
keep_uploads.description: Keep photos you uploaded yourself; remove everything else.

init.title: Video, Bluetooth, history & schedule settings
init.description:
The feeder serves its video to one consumer only: Scrypted. Paste Scrypted's rebroadcast URL for the feeder here so Home Assistant consumes that instead of opening a second stream on the device. Leave empty to use the device directly.

If the feeder's BLE MAC is known (once a Bluetooth proxy has seen it advertise), feed commands fall back to Bluetooth whenever the agent's Wi-Fi API is unreachable. Leave empty to disable the fallback.

Schedule-card writes (add/edit/remove/toggle) are refused until you turn this on — the MCU's per-entry time encoding is still unconfirmed, so a wrong table could dispense at the wrong time or amount.

Evidence, the event journal and training live in Home Assistant's own storage now, not on the feeder. Choose how long to keep them.

Paste Scrypted's own address (e.g. http://192.168.1.69:11080) to show a short video clip of each meal in the timeline, recorded by Scrypted's Events Recorder. Leave empty to show only photos.

Paste the vision judge's own address (e.g. http://192.168.1.69:9292/v1) to send each meal or uncertain visit's photos to a second-opinion vision model that can hide a false alarm or fix a name the built-in recognizer is unsure about. It never changes what counts as a meal, and it never trains the recognizer by itself. Leave empty (the default) to disable it. The model field selects which model alias to ask for; the feeder integration's own bake-off publishes a dedicated "qwen3-vl-4b" model.

Leaving CoralHub's server address blank keeps cat recognition exactly as it is today, using the feeder's built-in recognizer. Filling in CoralHub's own address (plus its API token, if CoralHub has one set) lets Kibble use CoralHub's Google Coral hardware for more accurate cat recognition. If CoralHub is ever unreachable, Kibble automatically falls back to today's built-in recognizer.

error.not_mac: Must be a MAC address, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.not_http: Must be an http:// or https:// URL.

speaker_busy.message: The feeder's speaker is already in use (another clip, or the vendor app): {error}

cue_cooldown.message: Call the cats is on cooldown, try again in a moment: {error}

feeder_not_ready.message: {name} has not answered since Home Assistant started, so it cannot be controlled yet. This clears by itself as soon as it responds; check that it is powered on and on Wi-Fi.

device_required.message: Say which feeder: {count} are set up, so device_id is required.

schedule_writes_disabled.message: Schedule writing is disabled until the time encoding is confirmed — see docs/schedule.

invalid_jpeg_data.message: The uploaded photo data isn't valid: {error}

feed_button_zero_amount.message: This feed button's own amount is set to 0 portions, so there's nothing to dispense.

feeder_unresponsive.title: {name} is not responding
feeder_unresponsive.description:
The feeder has not answered {failures} polls in a row (most recent error: {error}). Entities keep showing their last known values, not live ones, until it recovers.

Check that the feeder is powered on and connected to Wi-Fi, and that its `kibbled` agent is running. This resolves itself — and this issue clears — as soon as a poll succeeds again.

feeder_unresponsive_since_start.title: {name} is not responding
feeder_unresponsive_since_start.description:
The feeder has not answered any of the {failures} attempts Kibble has made since Home Assistant started (most recent error: {error}), so its entities show as unavailable and Kibble's actions are refused for now.

Check that the feeder is powered on and connected to Wi-Fi, that its address has not changed, and that its `kibbled` agent is running. Kibble keeps trying by itself: this resolves — and this issue clears — as soon as the feeder answers.
